note: docs/design/FLOOR.md § 11's `fx-elevator` (card#9566, AT-D3-23): the walk to and from the elevator. Every run but `repaint-a19` is fx-snapshot-4's four `aimla` seats over the shipped default map, as `scene_default` (fx-scene.json) replays them, with the scene's inputs, a seat moved to `stale` or `offline` in the snapshot where the run's note says it is held so; `repaint-a19` is `fx-coord`'s `coord` run cut after its first round. Every walk's segment and frame count is re-derived by the test from the scene the run draws, never stated here.
